direction: A complete rounded ptarmigan with short beak, folded wing, two sturdy bird feet and a short broad tail. Three branching crystalline needle fans echo the hoarfrost material; oval face, ray ticks, sword hands, trail charge and folio calendar remain fully live.
ornamentDirection: A compact open Arctic willow sprig with two curved leaves and a small catkin; natural habitat companion in the four native header placements, full bird artwork retained on larger faces.
